Those are the exact specs of the Fremont-built Long Range RWD that Tesla sold in Canada two years ago. The Shanghai-built version, the $39,490 CAD car Canadians haven’t been able to order since early October, is rated at 463 km and 6.2 seconds. The new numbers point to a different car from a different factory. more…
